brief:
US lawmakers called on the Trump administration to hold Israeli settlers accountable following an attack on Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine and Palestinian villagers, Middle East Eye reported. The incident prompted bipartisan concern over violence against journalists and civilians in the occupied territories.

The attack occurred amid recurring tensions between Israeli settlers and Palestinians in the West Bank, with lawmakers pressing for federal pressure on the Israeli government to prevent further assaults.
